paths.title: Where would you like stronger protection?
paths.description: For you: outpatient, dental or hospital. For your pet: a dedicated area of cover. Go directly to the topic you need.

items.title: More freedom for treatments that matter to you.
items.description: Depending on the plan, cover can include alternative practitioners, osteopathy, additional preventive care, glasses and other outpatient services.
items.decision: For people who use alternative practitioners, osteopathy, glasses or preventive care – and do not want to carry all of these costs themselves.

items.title: Choose dental quality – not just the lowest price.
items.description: Dental supplementary insurance can make out-of-pocket costs for prosthetics, treatment and preventive care more predictable. Reimbursement, limits and conditions matter.
items.decision: For people who do not want higher-quality dental care to depend on their bank balance.

highlight.label: Highlight · die Bayerische
highlight.title: ZAHN Sofort – even when treatment has already been recommended.
highlight.description: The optional module can cover treatment that has already been recommended or begun, without a waiting period.
highlight.note: The module currently costs 29.90 EUR per month. Completed and already invoiced treatment is not covered. The policy conditions apply.

items.cta: Explore instant protection and dental plans

items.title: Important decisions are better made before admission.
items.description: Depending on the plan, private medical treatment, a private or semi-private room and additional costs related to a wider hospital choice may be covered.
items.decision: For people who want more say over treatment and accommodation in hospital.

items.title: Protect against veterinary costs before they become a burden.
items.description: Depending on the plan, pet health or surgery insurance can cover high treatment costs after illness or an accident.
items.decision: For owners choosing between comprehensive health cover and focused surgery cover.

comparison.title: Not every gap is your gap.
comparison.description: The right protection starts with your priorities, not with a plan. These four questions create more clarity than any product shelf.

items.label: Outpatient
items.relevant: you regularly use services beyond statutory health insurance.
items.check: Which services are covered – and which budgets, reimbursement rates and exclusions apply?

items.label: Dental
items.relevant: you want higher-quality care for dental treatment and prosthetics.
items.check: How much is reimbursed, which limits apply in the first years – and what about treatment already recommended?

items.label: Hospital
items.relevant: you want more choice of doctor, hospital or room.
items.check: Which optional services and fee limits apply – and which health questions must you answer before taking out cover?

items.label: Pet
items.relevant: you want to make veterinary or surgery costs for your dog or cat more predictable.
items.check: Do you need comprehensive health cover or focused surgery cover – and which excess suits you?

advice.title: More modules do not automatically mean better protection.
advice.description: We do not recommend as much as possible. We recommend what fits your priorities, budget and situation. Sometimes that means several modules. Sometimes one is enough.
advice.rightQuestion: Which costs are you willing to carry when it matters?

criteria.title: Benefits before promises
criteria.description: What matters is what the plan provides under the agreed conditions – not how impressive an advertising percentage looks.

criteria.title: Make limits visible
criteria.description: Waiting periods, initial limits, maximum amounts and exclusions belong before the decision, not after it.

criteria.title: Needs before product
criteria.description: A strong plan is only strong when its benefits match your real priorities.

budget.title: When the elements work together, real room for health is created.
budget.description: With the outpatient Healio concept, a suitable health fund bonus and supplementary insurance can work together. We clearly explain the requirements and show what the calculation looks like for you.
budget.note: Actual benefits and your effective contribution depend on the selected plan, your personal situation and the health fund bonus you achieve.

process.title: A good decision does not require insurance language.
process.description: We translate conditions into clear consequences and remain personally available after the policy begins.

steps.title: Clarify priorities
steps.description: We start with your daily life, your preferences and the costs you do not want to carry yourself.

steps.title: Understand conditions
steps.description: Benefits, limits and relevant differences are explained in clear language.

steps.title: Decide consciously
steps.description: You choose the cover that fits – and continue to have a personal contact afterwards.

pet.title: Looking for health insurance for your pet?
pet.description: Healio has a dedicated area for this – clearly separate from your own supplementary health insurance.
